outcome: Use of neuraxial anesthesia for cesarean delivery
finding: Black and American Indian or Alaska Native parturients had lower odds of receiving neuraxial anesthesia compared to White parturients, while there was no significant difference between non-Hispanic and Hispanic parturients.
mod_finding: This study found racial differences in the use of neuraxial anesthesia for cesarean delivery, with Black and American Indian or Alaska Native parturients having lower odds of receiving neuraxial anesthesia compared to White parturients.
